project_overview: This Vue.js project appears to be a web application focused on educational services, likely related to exam management and student interaction. The application utilizes Vue components to structure various user interfaces, including examination forms, results pages, and interactive learning modules. Router navigation connects these components, suggesting a client-side routing strategy. The presence of multiple 'ApplicationServices' components indicates a potential modular architecture.

layers.description: Handles the core logic of the application.

macro_trends.title: Potential UI Component Over-reliance
macro_trends.description: Multiple Vue components (e.g., ExamFormSubmission, iLikeCourses, ResultPage) are directly connected through routing, suggesting a potential dependency on specific UI patterns within these components. This could lead to maintenance challenges if these patterns change. Further investigation into the code within these components is warranted.

macro_trends.title: High Issue Density in Key Components
macro_trends.description: The ExamFormSubmission component has a high number of identified issues (5), indicating potential areas of instability, accessibility problems, or security vulnerabilities that require immediate attention. This warrants a deep dive to mitigate these issues before deployment.

key_workflows.name: Exam Submission Workflow
key_workflows.description: The flow of data and interactions related to submitting an exam, starting with the ExamFormSubmission component, traversing through potential Transactions and ApplicationServices, and ultimately displaying the results in ResultPage and potentially SelectedApplicationService. This workflow presents a significant number of dependencies and potential points of failure.
